prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a sideswipe while changing lanes. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1361; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Inspection confirms a sideswipe pattern along the right rear quarter panel, with scraping and a deep dent running into the rear door skin and a cracked taillight lens on the same side. Damage is mostly in line with the impact described by the insured. Repair plan calls for replacing the rear bumper cover, straightening the door, refinishing the affected panels, and installing a new lens assembly. The labor hours requested fit the extent of the work. The shop's invoices show no repeated charges, and no earlier damage to this vehicle is known from our records. Estimate is recommended for approval as submitted.
